# Humankind Movement

> Humankind Movement is the movement-coaching practice of Ajith Jagadish, a certified Human Biomechanics Specialist based in Bengaluru, India. Most coaching is online for clients around the world, with limited in-person sessions in Bengaluru. The philosophy is health before success and awareness before action. Coaching starts with how a person breathes and moves, not with a generic programme.

Not to be confused with other organisations that use the name Humankind. Coaching is education and movement guidance, not medical care or a substitute for physiotherapy.

## Who we are

- [About: Ajith Jagadish and Vijay D.](https://humankindmovement.in/about): The two coaches. Ajith is a certified Human Biomechanics Specialist and former national and international athlete. Vijay D. is a coach for movement and sport.
- [Philosophy](https://humankindmovement.in/philosophy): The ideas the coaching, programmes and writing are built on.
- [The Humankind Method](https://humankindmovement.in/the-method): A five-step cycle: Notice, Understand, Align, Practice, Reflect.
- [Who we serve](https://humankindmovement.in/who-we-serve): People of all ages, life stages and abilities, including neurodivergent individuals, families, organisations and international clients.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://humankindmovement.in/services)
- [One-to-one and group coaching](https://humankindmovement.in/services/one-to-one-coaching): Movement, habits, aches and pains, injury recovery and lasting change.
- [Postpartum and return-to-movement support](https://humankindmovement.in/services/postpartum-support): Diastasis recti, core restoration and pelvic stability, with no bounce-back pressure.
- [Neurodivergent movement coaching](https://humankindmovement.in/services/neurodivergent-coaching): Strengths-led, sensory-aware coaching for neurodivergent people of all ages.
- [Workshops](https://humankindmovement.in/services/workshops): For groups, communities, schools and organisations.
- [Corporate and community wellbeing](https://humankindmovement.in/services/corporate-wellbeing)
- [Movement coaching in Bengaluru and online](https://humankindmovement.in/movement-coaching-bengaluru): How online and in-person coaching work, and what they cost.

## Key facts

- Languages: English, Spanish (/es/) and French (/fr/).
- Delivery: mostly online across time zones; limited in-person coaching in Bengaluru.
- Pricing is set in Indian rupees. A 20-minute introduction call is INR 1,000. Online one-to-one sessions typically range from INR 1,000 to INR 2,500.
- Contact: https://humankindmovement.in/contact
